human_description: Open a VQX frame or semantic unit.
Close a VQX frame or semantic unit.
Protocol version marker. The actual protocol version is carried by framing or envelope metadata.
Frame flags / option bits follow in context.
Continuation of the previous semantic unit.
Illocution: request an action or response from the addressee.
Successful completion of the requested work.
Terminal failure of the requested work.
Length prefix for the following value (implementation-defined integer encoding).
Dictionary identity / SHA-256 prefix follows in the transport envelope, not in-band as raw ASCII.
The human user / operator of record.
A tool, function, or external capability.
A privileged operator distinct from the end user.
A human in the loop, not necessarily the user of record.
Produce a response to the addressee.
Warn about risk or side effects.
Retract a prior statement or commit.
Perform internal reasoning; do not emit chain-of-thought unless policy allows.
Search an index, web, or corpus.
Transform data from one representation to another.
Execute a tool or plan. Does not grant authorization by itself.
Hand off work and relevant state to another role.
Verify a claim, artifact, or checksum.
Install a codec, dictionary, or tool. Authorization required.
Discover protocol documents from a well-known URL.
Generic object of the preceding act.
The VQX codec/dictionary package as install target.
Waiting for input or a timer.
Type tag for the following value.
Key identifier, not a raw secret.
Expiration of a lease or cache.
Confidence marker; following token or envelope carries the value.
Claim is grounded in retrieved evidence.
Confidence is calibrated against a scoring rule.
Response body must contain only valid VQX semantic tokens or VQX protocol framing. No ordinary natural-language prose in the payload.
Natural-language prose is permitted in the response payload.
Return the final answer only; omit scratch work.
Minimize model-token usage subject to fidelity.
Search if needed; skip if already grounded.
Use a tool if needed; skip if not.
Preserve task context across the handoff.
Preserve standing constraints across the handoff.
Human approval is required before proceeding.
Evaluate whether VQX compact form is smaller than the fallback representation before switching.
Sender asserts compact mode is acceptable for subsequent payloads.
A numeric or policy limit follows.
Treat as secret; do not echo.
Payload is signed. Signature proves key possession, not authorization.
Sender authenticity established for this message.
Confidentiality via an outer cryptographic envelope. Encoding is not encryption.
Peer is on the local trust list (policy, not protocol).
Inline digest of the following payload.
Referent not found. (Also the first magic byte of the VQX beacon when used as prefix, not as this token.)
Dictionary hash mismatch. Fail closed; do not guess.
Protocol version mismatch. Fail closed; do not guess.
Define a session-local macro: following byte is slot 0xE0–0xFF, then a length-prefixed token sequence.
Reference a session-local macro; following byte is the slot.
Clear session-local macros. Never persist across unrelated peers.
Hash of the current local macro table, for stateless transports.
